comment: Red team 1_7 (u_turn, aimed at #7,#1,#9,#3,#4): The squad runs echelon_left along a wall, then U-turns tightly round its free end. Trailing men cut the end and get occluded, men face the wall end at close range, and the echelon-column-echelon refold may flicker or never settle on the return leg. Broke 3 (check, choice, members): #3 flicker. First: #3 auto n2 R1 s1 t=24.3s - echelon_left -> wedge, back after 3.3 s.
